title: @auto_tlrc
description: A script to transform an anatomical dataset to align with some standard space template and to apply the same TLRC transform obtained with @auto_tlrc in Usage 1 mode to other datasets.

base_template.description: Reference anatomical volume. Usually this volume is in some standard space like TLRC or MNI space.
base_template.title: Base Template

input_anat.description: Original anatomical volume (+orig). The skull is removed by this script unless instructed otherwise (-no_ss).
input_anat.title: Input Anatomical Volume

no_ss.description: Do not strip skull of input data set because the skull has already been removed or because the template still has the skull.
no_ss.title: No Skull Stripping

warp_orig_vol.description: Produce a TLRC version of the input volume, rather than a TLRC version of the skull-stripped input.
warp_orig_vol.title: Warp Original Volume

dxyz.description: Cubic voxel size of output DSET in TLRC space. Default is the resolution of the template.
dxyz.title: Cubic Voxel Size

dx.description: Size of voxel in the x direction (Right-Left). Default is 1mm.
dx.title: Voxel Size in X Direction

dy.description: Size of voxel in the y direction (Anterior-Posterior). Default is 1mm.
dy.title: Voxel Size in Y Direction

dz.description: Size of voxel in the z direction (Inferior-Superior). Default is 1mm.
dz.title: Voxel Size in Z Direction

pad_base.description: Pad the base dataset by MM mm in each direction. Default is 15 mm.
pad_base.title: Pad Base Dataset

clean.description: Clean all temporary files, likely left from -keep_tmp option then exit.
clean.title: Clean Temporary Files

xform.description: Transform to use for warping: Choose from affine_general or shift_rotate_scale. Default is affine_general.
xform.title: Transform for Warping

no_avoid_eyes.description: An option that gets passed to 3dSkullStrip. Use it when parts of the frontal lobes get clipped.
no_avoid_eyes.title: No Avoid Eyes

ncr.description: Do not use -coarserot option for 3dWarpDrive, which is a default.
ncr.title: No Coarse Rotation

onepass.description: Turns off -twopass option for 3dWarpDrive. This will speed up the registration but might fail if the datasets are far apart.
onepass.title: Single Pass Registration

maxite.description: Maximum number of iterations for 3dWarpDrive. Default is 50 for first pass and then doubled to 100 in second pass.
maxite.title: Maximum Number of Iterations

not_OK_maxite.description: Continue running even if maximum iterations is reached.
not_OK_maxite.title: Not OK Maximum Iterations

inweight.description: Apply -weight INPUT (in 3dWarpDrive). By default, 3dWarpDrive uses the BASE dataset to weight the alignment cost.
inweight.title: Input Weight

rigid_equiv.description: Output the rigid-body version of the alignment. Resultant volume is NOT in TLRC space.
rigid_equiv.title: Rigid Body Alignment

init_xform.description: Apply affine transform in XFORM0.1D before beginning registration and then include XFORM0.1D in the final transform.
init_xform.title: Initial Transform

out_space.description: Set the output to a particular space.
out_space.title: Output Space

3dAllineate.description: Use 3dAllineate with the lpa+ZZ cost function instead of 3dWarpDrive.
3dAllineate.title: Use 3dAllineate

3dAlcost.description: Use another cost function like nmi for 3dAllineate.
3dAlcost.title: Cost function for 3dAllineate

apar.description: An anatomical dataset in TLRC space created using Usage 1 of @auto_tlrc.
apar.title: Anatomical Dataset Parent

input_dataset.description: Dataset (typically EPI time series or statistical dataset) to transform to TLRC space per the transform in TLRC_parent
input_dataset.title: Input Dataset

pad_input.description: Pad the input dataset by MM mm in each direction.
pad_input.title: Pad Input Dataset

onewarp.description: Create follower data with one interpolation step, instead of two. This option reduces blurring of the output data.
onewarp.title: Single Interpolation Step

twowarp.description: Create follower data with two interpolations step, instead of one. This option is for backward compatibility.
twowarp.title: Two Interpolation Steps

rmode.description: Resampling mode. Choose from: linear, cubic, NN or quintic. Default for 'Usage 1' is cubic.
rmode.title: Resampling Mode

suffix.description: Name the output dataset by appending this suffix to the prefix of the input data.
suffix.title: Output Suffix

keep_view.description: Do not mark output dataset as +tlrc.
keep_view.title: Keep Output View

base_list.description: List the full path of the base dataset.
base_list.title: List Base Dataset Path

use_gz.description: When using '-suffix ..', behave as if you had provided a prefix with '*.gz' at the end.
use_gz.title: Use GZIP Compression
